contract_material.canonical_question: Which of the 10 scoring components best predict actual R-multiple outcomes?
Is the system's predicted probability (p_success) calibrated to actual win rate?
Does the pre-decision predicted-EV (R units) gate relate to subsequent realised R?
Does the canonical pre-decision score (score_strategy) separate subsequent realised R, and is a discovery-selected threshold supported on later unseen data?
Do rejected/no-trade canonical opportunities subsequently show counterfactual shadow outcomes indicating the rejection logic filters harmful or discards useful opportunities?
Does the portfolio ranker's ordering of candidates (by rank_position) match realised/shadow outcomes — i.e., do higher-ranked candidates genuinely outperform lower-ranked ones?
What is the true expectancy of the production decision pipeline measured by R-multiple per trade?
Which candlestick patterns contain positive expectancy across all conditions?
Which active non-NONE V10 StrategyFamily values contain positive expectancy on completed primary shadow outcomes?
Which strategy × pattern combinations produce edge? (e.g. REVERSAL + TWEEZER_TOP)
Does the measured edge survive on unseen market data using walk-forward testing with rolling windows?
Does modifying exit policy (trailing stop, reduced TP, time-based) improve system expected value compared to the current max_bars timeout?
Does the exit policy improvement hold on out-of-sample data using time-ordered walk-forward validation?
Does a trailing stop mechanism capture more of the available MFE than the current exit, using bar-by-bar sequential simulation?
What take-profit distance maximises expectancy? Tests TP at 0.25R through 3.0R using MFE data to determine reachability.
Does the current SL distance preserve signal quality, or does widening/tightening SL improve outcomes?
Does trade horizon (SCALP/INTRADAY/EXTENDED) require a different exit policy? Tests trailing parameters per horizon.
Does each strategy family (REVERSAL/MOMENTUM/CONTINUATION) require a different exit policy?
Does market regime (TRENDING/RANGING/TRANSITIONAL) require a different exit policy?
Do different candlestick patterns require different exit policies based on their MFE/MAE profiles?
Does the proposed exit policy reduce the timeout exit rate and convert timeout losses into captured profits?
Do execution failures or adverse conditions degrade otherwise valid opportunities?
Is the current dataset suitable for the intended research questions? (field coverage, source type, sample size)
What percentage of canonical opportunities have valid decision-to-outcome lineage on (entity_id, canonical_opportunity_id)?
Can research conclusions be trusted given current validation status, coverage percentages, and sample sizes?

Within-opportunity comparison: for each canonical opportunity with simulated outcomes for the selected horizon AND >=1 alternative horizon, was the selection supported by subsequent evidence? Simulated counterfactuals on shadow-observed opportunities.
Are patterns degrading in performance over time?
Does the system improve after architecture changes? (compare pre/post periods)
Are the scoring weight assumptions, regime classifications, and strategy mappings still correct?
Does market behaviour change over time in ways that invalidate strategy assumptions?
Do patterns, strategies, or market assumptions lose predictive power over time?
How trustworthy is each research conclusion given dataset validity, coverage, and sample size?
Does a proposed strategy change outperform the currently promoted version when evaluated in shadow mode with statistical significance?
Does H4 regime classification (TRENDING/RANGING/TRANSITIONAL) predict trade R-multiple?
Does each market phase require a different strategy family (reversal, continuation, momentum, breakout) rather than different pattern weighting within one family?
Does market context (regime + phase + bias) provide more predictive value for trade outcomes than the pattern identity itself?
Which H4 regimes produce edge for each strategy type?
Does market_phase (IMPULSE/PULLBACK/CONSOLIDATION/EXHAUSTION/REVERSAL) improve prediction beyond H4 regime alone?
Which regime × phase × strategy combinations produce edge?
Do rapid phase transitions predict subsequent realised strategy drawdown in cumulative R? This is not account-equity or mark-to-market drawdown.
Which market phases (IMPULSE/PULLBACK/CONSOLIDATION/EXHAUSTION/REVERSAL) contain real edge?
Does combining regime and phase improve predictive power beyond either alone?
Do market phase transitions (e.g. IMPULSE→EXHAUSTION) predict future trade outcomes?
For each market phase (IMPULSE, PULLBACK, CONSOLIDATION, EXHAUSTION, REVERSAL), which patterns or behaviours actually belong there and produce positive expectancy?
Observational association between management actions and realised outcomes. NOT causal.
Per-action-type outcome analysis (SLTP_MODIFY, PARTIAL_CLOSE, CLOSE). OBSERVATIONAL.
Were the opportunities promoted into the decision pipeline better than the opportunities rejected or filtered out?
If a specific recommendation is promoted into production, what measurable improvement in EV, win rate, drawdown, trade frequency, and risk is expected?

Did the portfolio/ranking layer select the best available opportunity from the ranked candidate set? Evaluates whether the selected candidate's outcome is competitive with the best-ranked candidate in the same cycle.
Are positions retaining the protection (SL/TP) the system intended?
Does the risk layer (guards, daily loss limit, exposure) improve overall expectancy and survival?
Did each individual guard (spread, correlation, regime, daily loss) improve final expectancy?
Given the measured edge, win rate, variance and position sizing, what is the probability that this system eventually reaches catastrophic drawdown?
At what realised drawdown should the system automatically suspend trading because historical recovery probability becomes unacceptable?
What position sizing model (fixed risk, Kelly, half-Kelly, fractional Kelly, fixed lot, dynamic) maximises long-term growth while respecting acceptable drawdown?
When the bot realises a loss, does the realised loss magnitude respect the 1-R planned-risk definition? How often do realised losses exceed the plan (ELEVATED/CRITICAL)?
Superseded alias of E3: expectancy for each active non-NONE V10 StrategyFamily on completed primary shadow outcomes.
Does trade horizon (SCALP/INTRADAY/EXTENDED) independently affect expectancy?
Which strategy × horizon combinations work? (e.g. REVERSAL+SCALP vs CONTINUATION+EXTENDED)
Are strategies specialised for certain market phases? (e.g. REVERSAL only in EXHAUSTION)
Which active non-NONE V10 StrategyFamily values retain expectancy after accounting for the evaluated trade horizon (SCALP/INTRADAY/EXTENDED) under which outcomes were simulated?
Which canonical trade horizons (SCALP/INTRADAY/EXTENDED) retain expectancy after accounting for the six active V10 StrategyFamily values?
Are strategies profitable only at specific horizons? (e.g. REVERSAL works at SCALP but not EXTENDED)

Ranking/monotonicity analysis of pre-decision strategy-selection confidence against subsequent primary-horizon shadow outcomes. NOT calibration (confidence is a relative score). Rejected strategies have no simulated outcomes — selection optimality cannot yet be proven.
What is the real slippage model per symbol per session?
Are broker rejections/failures predictable by time, symbol, or market condition?
Which trading sessions produce the best execution quality (lowest slippage, fewest rejects)?
How much theoretical edge (from shadow R) is lost during real execution?
Does pre-decision predicted EV (predicted_ev_r_v1, R units) correspond to subsequent realised R at canonical-opportunity level, and does it persist on later unseen evidence?
Under what conditions (symbol, session, spread, volatility) does execution quality degrade?
